label: Multirate time stepping
subgoals: List the step each block needs
Compare the global-step work with the sum of per-block work
Weigh the speedup against interpolation across block boundaries

label: Latency and event-driven evaluation
subgoals: Count the active partitions per step
Add the cost of checking the latent ones
Divide the all-evaluated cost by the result

label: Partitioned matrix solves
subgoals: Cube the block sizes and sum them with the interface
Divide the unpartitioned cost by the partitioned cost
Cut partitions where coupling is weak
